text: Mongolian aaruul is the curd of soured or yoghurt-fermented milk, drained in cloth, pressed, cut and dried in sun and air on the yurt roof. It becomes a hard snack that keeps through winter.

links.name: Jargalsaikhan & Dorjsuren, Mong. J. Agric. Sci. (2024)
